descriptor: Web design studio turning ideas into websites

voice.summary: Weblex talks like a confident designer who ships quickly: short sentences, direct promises and an electric-lime accent for emphasis. It keeps jargon out of the headline and puts the big idea first.
dos: Lead with the outcome: idea to website
Keep nav labels to one word
Use bold verbs: build, launch, ship
donts: Do not use long agency boilerplate

taglines: Turn your big idea into a website
Build the thing. Ship the thing
boilerplate: Weblex is a web design studio that turns founders' big ideas into polished, launch-ready websites, with clear pricing and a fast process.

microcopy.success: Request received. We will reply within a day.
microcopy.error: That did not send. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No projects yet. Start with your big idea.

logo.note: A globe stands for the web and a studio that works for sites around the world.
